requirements.text: Allow students to personalise their timetable by colour-coding modules
Provide a toggle function to hide or show cancelled classes
Implement a drag-and-drop feature for adding and labelling study blocks
Enable exporting or syncing the personalised timetable with external calendar applications like Google Calendar or Outlook
Send notifications for new grades posted for any enrolled modules
Incorporate reminders for upcoming deadlines, with customizable triggers for notifications
Allow students to choose their preferred method of receiving notifications (email, SMS, or in-app)
Provide options for students to configure how frequently they wish to receive notifications (immediately, daily, or weekly summaries)
Deliver grade notifications within five minutes of grades being posted by lecturers
Gather structured feedback from students on module content quality, teaching effectiveness, and resource adequacy
Ensure the feedback submission process is user-friendly and straightforward
Keep the feedback form concise with around 5-10 targeted questions
Ensure anonymity by aggregating feedback to prevent identification of individual responses
Set a closing date for feedback submission that aligns with the grade submission deadline
Maintain compliance with GDPR and data retention policies
